items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Rene left to go to Tulane. He went to take up architecture and that's when Nappy took his place.

ctx.x: Did you have Nappy and Rene in the band at the same time?
No, no, no. Rene left to go to Tulane. He went to take up architecture and that's when Nappy took his place.

items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: I don't think Rene would play guitar. Not with us, anyway

ctx.x: I missed all that now. Did Rene Jalpe ever play guitar?
To my knowledge, no. I don't think Rene would play guitar. Not with us, anyway, if he went along there. But you said that they had two.
